documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half-Year Ended September 30, 2026

Board Meeting Intimation for Considering, Approving & Taking On Record The Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026 And To Conduct Any Other Businesses As May Be Decided By The Board.
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On Friday, November 06, 2026

analysis.summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited reported a 58% year-on-year revenue increase to INR 853.63 crores in Q1 FY27, driven by strong wedding and festive demand. Operating profitability also expanded, with EBITDA increasing 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores and EBITDA margin reaching 11.01%. Management highlighted network expansion plans, including opening new showrooms in Dahod and Jabalpur, as part of a long-term vision to reach 51 stores. Additionally, the company is targeting 10% annual volume growth for FY27 and FY28 while expanding its digital and omnichannel sales channels.

guidance.claim: The company targets approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: The company aims to expand its total network to 51 stores.
guidance.quote: our overall plan remains broadly unchanged we aim to reach a total of 51 stores, and the majority of these will continue to be under the Company-Owned, Company-Operated (COCO) model.

guidance.claim: Management targets increasing its overall studded jewellery mix to between 12% and 15% by March 2028.
guidance.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

guidance.claim: Fit-out and development activities are progressing for upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur and Dahod, which are expected to open shortly.
guidance.quote: Fit-out and showroom development activities are progressing at both locations, and the stores are expected to become operational shortly.

guidance.claim: The company plans to expand into Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, and Maharashtra over the next 5 years.
guidance.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve an annual revenue growth rate of 25% to 30% by the end of 2030.
guidance.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue growth of around 20% going forward.
guidance.quote: Yes, we are confident of achieving growth of around 20% going forward, driven by strong wedding demand in the country.

guidance.claim: The company targets an EBITDA margin of around 6% to 6.5%.
guidance.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

guidance.claim: Management plans for revenue of INR 4,800 crores in FY27 and INR 5,500 crores in FY28.
guidance.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

guidance.claim: The company targets EBITDA margins between 8% and 8.5% by FY30.
guidance.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

demand_outlook.claim: A sharp correction in gold prices in June helped improve buying sentiment in the jewellery segment.
demand_outlook.quote: However, the sharp correction in gold prices during June, followed by relative stability in July, helped improve buying sentiment, especially in the jewellery segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Store footfall showed a footfall-to-conversion ratio of 81% during Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q1 FY27, footfall at our stores was encouraging, and the footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81%, showing strong buying intent and effective in-store engagement.

demand_outlook.claim: The average ticket size was approximately Rs. 1,57,000 in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: During the quarter, our average ticket size was approximately Rs. 1,57,000, supported by wedding-led purchases and festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Wedding-related purchases accounted for 62% of sales in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of product category mix, wedding related purchases remained the largest contributor, accounting for 62% of the sales during the quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue increased by 58% YoY in Q1 FY27, driven by festive purchases and the summer wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue grew by 58 % YoY, supported by strong festive purchases during key occasions such as Akshaya Tritiya, Poila Baisakh, Baisakhi, along with the onset of the summer wedding season.

demand_outlook.claim: End-market customer demand remained healthy during the quarter across both consumption and investment channels.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across our markets during the quarter, supported by both consumption-led and investment-led purchases.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange transactions strengthened, contributing around 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Following recent government announcements and heightened customer awareness, participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further, with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in FY26 was primarily driven by value as overall volume declined around 20%.
demand_outlook.quote: In FY26, most of our growth was driven by value rather than volume. On the volume side, we actually saw a decline of around 20% overall.

demand_outlook.claim: Silver demand remains intact with customers shifting towards silver amidst higher gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Silver demand remains intact. In fact, with gold prices increasing and impacting demand, we are seeing a shift towards silver.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in April and mid-May was good with healthy customer walk-ins.
demand_outlook.quote: So, far as April and mid-May, when we look at, this is before PM comment. So, I think the growth was doing good.

demand_outlook.claim: Recent fluctuations in gold prices had some impact on customer demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Recently, we have seen some impact due to fluctuations in gold prices.

capex_expansion.claim: The company finalized a 3,200 sq. ft. COCO showroom in Dahod to enter the Gujarat market.
capex_expansion.quote: The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and will mark our strategic entry into the Gujarat market.

capex_expansion.claim: The company finalized a 3,750 sq. ft. showroom in Jabalpur under its first FOCO model.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second showroom, in Jabalpur, will be approximately 3,750 sq. ft. and will be our first Franchisee-Owned Company-Operated model showroom.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores.

capex_expansion.claim: D.P. Abhushan launched its e-commerce website and mobile application during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: This quarter, we launched our e-commerce website and mobile application, which are now available on both the Play Store and App Store.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open three to four new stores this year across focus states.
capex_expansion.quote: As mentioned earlier, we are focusing on expansion across Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Chhattisgarh, and Maharashtra. For this year, we have planned to open three to four new stores.

capex_expansion.claim: D.P. Abhushan has finalized one franchisee and plans to open one franchise store.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we have already finalized one franchisee and will be opening one franchise store as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has a long-term goal to reach around 51 stores by 2030.
capex_expansion.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is targeting store expansion in Jaipur in the next one to two years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin expanded to 7.55% in Q1 FY27, up 82 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin expanded to 7.55%, up 82 basis points year-on-year, reflecting strong profitability growth and sustained efficiency across the businesses.

margins_costs.claim: The majority of margin improvement during the quarter came from higher making charges realization.
margins_costs.quote: The majority of the improvement has come from higher making charges.

margins_costs.claim: The company utilizes Gold Metal Loans and hedging mechanisms to protect margin stability against gold price volatility.
margins_costs.quote: Continue to follow a disciplined approach towards gold procurement and inventory management, exchange gold, leveraging Gold Metal Loans (GMLs) and hedging mechanisms at commodity exchange platform to mitigate gold price volatility while supporting margin stability and working capital efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin stood at 5.45% with EBITDA reaching INR 73 crores.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at INR73 crores, up 72% YoY. EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 5.45%.

margins_costs.claim: Full-year FY26 EBITDA margin improved by 234 basis points YoY to 7.61%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR309.7 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 77% YoY, with EBITDA margins improving to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects gross margins to remain around 10% to 11%.
margins_costs.quote: As far as gross margins are concerned, we expect the business to maintain approximately 10% to 11%.

orders_capacity.claim: Same-store sales growth reached 52% on an overall basis in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Our same-store sales growth stood at 52% on an overall basis.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates with an annual inventory turnover ratio between 4.7x and 5.0x.
orders_capacity.quote: Our business currently operates with an inventory turnover ratio of around 4.7x to 5.0x annually, which, in our view, is among the best in the industry.

orders_capacity.claim: Centralized purchasing in Ratlam supports store inventory flow across a 300-kilometer radius.
orders_capacity.quote: Centralized purchasing at Ratlam ensures smooth inventory flow, minimizing dead stock and maximizing operational efficiency across all stores within a 300-kilometer radius

orders_capacity.claim: Total retail store area reached approximately 53,650 square feet.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total retail store area stood at ~53,650 sq. ft. supporting our growing scale of operations.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expanded its total showroom network to 12 stores following additions in Ratlam and Dhar.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new s in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12.

capital_allocation.claim: Inventory comprises nearly 95% to 98% of the company's total assets on the balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: When we look at our balance sheet, almost 95% to 98% of our assets consist of inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilizes exchange-led gold procurement, gold metal loans, and MCX hedging to manage price risk and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to leverage exchange led procurement of gold, gold metal loan, and hedging mechanisms on the commodity exchange platform to mitigate gold price volatility, support margin stability, and improve working capital efficiency.

capital_allocation.claim: Management targets improved capital efficiency by relying more on gold exchanges and structured schemes rather than fresh gold procurement.
capital_allocation.quote: Reducing dependence on fresh gold procurement through exchange-led scheme and Structured Gold Savings Accumulation Scheme, thereby improving capital efficiency and sustaining sales even at higher gold prices.

capital_allocation.claim: The planned QIP has been put on hold due to unfavorable market conditions.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we are planning to undertake a QIP; however, we have currently put it on hold as market conditions are not favourable.

capital_allocation.claim: Store expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 will be executed using internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: As far as our expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 are concerned, they will be executed through internal accruals as well.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not planned for any long-term borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: No, we have not yet planned for any long-term borrowings.

risks_headwinds.claim: The gold import duty increase from 6% to 15% in May 2026 introduced short-term cost and demand sensitivity.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the recent government announcement and increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 has introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity, the long-term fundamentals of the sector remain intact, supported by India’s cultural affinity for gold, wedding and festive led demand, rising formalisation, omnichannel adoption.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sharp short-term increases in gold prices cause customer demand to temporarily pause.
risks_headwinds.quote: What we have observed over many years in this industry is that whenever gold prices rise sharply in a short period of time, demand tends to pause temporarily.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Indian government increased import duties on gold and silver from approximately 6% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Government raised the import duty on gold (and silver) from ~6% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: High gold prices are expected to create weaker jewellery consumption in India during 2026.
risks_headwinds.quote: India’s gold demand is projected to remain in the range of 600–700 tonnes in 2026, with rising investment demand offsetting weaker jewellery consumption due to elevated gold prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: High and volatile gold prices throughout FY26 impacted consumer affordability and buying patterns.
risks_headwinds.quote: Throughout FY26, gold prices were on an upward trajectory and quite volatile, which impacted affordability and consumer buying patterns.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Prime Minister's remarks regarding gold purchases may create a slight short-term sentiment impact.
risks_headwinds.quote: See, the Prime Minister’s statement may have a slight short-term impact on sentiment, but overall, we believe the underlying demand for gold remains strong.

management_commitments.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
